whole_comparison.scope: QKV-only comparison in one allocation; complete original standard hosts. Candidate FFN source differs (E137 vs E142) and its timing is not compared. Diagnostic timings are not promotion measurements.

method: Three original inputs, two clusters per trace, one allocation. Times relative to each cluster Task. All native markers checked against entire source-schedule sequence and issue order.
limitations: Marker intervals include queue/dependency waits and are not isolated service times.
Interval metrics are elapsed windows, not sums of overlapping durations.

Trace timestamps and info/whole standard host timings have different profiling modes; trace is not a speedup/adoption sample. Candidate and control standard FFN differ, so only QKV timings are compared.
Moving quantization changes input transfer, active DM, reduction ratio and schedule; an observed interval is not its predicted net saving.
A prefix-ready delta is observed; no causal bus stall fraction is inferred without a supported dependency edge.
